   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      18 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.06.2026 - 21.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _C0NN0RAD0_, 21.08.2026, 1/5: "I used to really love opal but the last few months it’s went really down hill and very buggy, I often find it not locking apps at the end of breaks, certain rules not staying paused or reset despite asking them to be reset or paused for xyz time, the app frequently freezing. I can no longer rely on it to reliably enforce screen time and habits."
            2. _f_hooper_, 16.08.2026, 1/5: "So disappointed by the new update, used to use this app all the time and it was so helpful; now it's unusable and cash-grabby. Will be deleting and trying something else."
            3. _S.ley1'_, 04.08.2026, 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
